current_evidence: Not read directly (shared WebFetch and WebSearch budgets ran out). A hounslow.gov.uk-restricted search shows the council publishes separate per-application-type checklists in its downloads area (e.g. downloads/file/11160/outline-planning-application, titled 'Validation checklist v.8'), linked from the Apply for planning permission page. A Citizen Space consultation 'Proposed Changes To Our Planning Validation Checklist' also exists, so the version in force and its date could not be confirmed.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link is a single application-type checklist (Full planning, major or minor), not Hounslow's whole local list. Hounslow publishes a separate checklist for each application type (e.g. an Outline planning application checklist, 'Validation checklist v.8'). Grokbot read only the full planning one and then recorded '(none)' for every other type.
issues.evidence: URL slug 'full-planning-major-or-minor-checklist'; search result 'Validation checklist v.8' at hounslow.gov.uk/downloads/file/11160/outline-planning-application

issues.detail: Householder, Outline, Reserved matters, Advertisement consent, Lawful development certificate, Prior approval, Demolition in a conservation area, s73, Discharge of conditions, Non-material amendment, Works to trees and PiP are all '(none)' / 'national requirements only'. That is because their checklists were never read, not because Hounslow has no local requirements for them; the outline checklist, for one, exists. The specific missing items could not be listed because the per-type checklists could not be fetched this run.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows: Householder '(none)'; Outline '(none)'; docs_read lists only the full planning checklist and the apply page

issues.detail: The list date 2020-01-01 is taken from PDF CreationDate metadata, not from a date in the text. The checklists are version-numbered ('v.8') and have been through a public consultation on changes, so the date in force is unverified and may be later.
issues.evidence: reference_row Date basis: 'PDF metadata CreationDate'; search result 'Proposed Changes To Our Planning Validation Checklist - London Borough of Hounslow - Citizen Space'

issues.detail: Most tab_items are process text or links, not requirements: 'Number of copies... 2 paper copies and 1 CD'; 'controversial... further paper copies and CDs may be requested'; 'Only in exceptional circumstances will a paper copy... be accepted'; 'Where an application is invalid, the Council will write contact the agent...'; 'The data standard can be viewed at the link below: combined_planning_data_standard_0.pdf'; and 'Additional details may be required for certain development, including:' (a fragment). The Drawing standards items (plans, elevations, north point, scale bar) are national requirements. The Contaminated Land Strategy / Drainage Assessment Form item merges a weblink with a requirement.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'The data standard can be viewed at the link below: combined_planning_data_standard_0.pdf'

issues.detail: Several triggers come from the wrong row of the checklist table; the headings and descriptions look offset by one row. 'Health Impact Assessment', 'Landscaping scheme' and 'Statement of Community Involvement' all carry the trigger 'Required to demonstrate what the proposed finish materials of the development are', which is the Details of materials description. 'Ecological Survey' carries the Retail / Office Assessment text. 'Environmental Statement' and 'Roof plan' share one excerpt that mixes 'Existing and proposed roof plans', 'Scaled at 1:50 or 1:100' and the EIA text. Air Quality ('required for air quality assessments and further guidance...'), Sunlight to gardens ('significantly modify garden areas.') and Parking ('reduce existing parking provisions...') are cut-off fragments with no usable trigger.
issues.evidence: Health Impact Assessment trigger_excerpt: 'Safety Audit Health Impact Assessment Required to demonstrate what the proposed finish materials of the development are.'

issues.detail: Some requirement names do not match their source text. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is mapped to the Design and Construction Method Statement trigger (major developments or any basement). 'Marketing / vacancy evidence (loss of use)' is mapped to the retail impact assessment trigger. 'CIL Additional Information / Form' and 'Planning Obligations / S106 draft Heads of Terms' are both mapped to a general sentence about CIL Regulations 122/123, which gives no trigger.
issues.evidence: Schedule of works trigger_excerpt: 'Applications for major developments, or any develop which includes the creation of a basement, should submit details of how onsite impacts will be managed during the demolition/construction phase'

issues.detail: 'Archaeological Assessment', 'Character / Conservation area appraisal' and 'Lighting Assessment' are filed under Listed building consent, but they come from the Full planning checklist. The lighting trigger is about development near a listed building or conservation area, not LBC applications. The ~20 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED ... check source', which is misleading because the source document is itself the Full planning checklist. Several of those items are major-only (e.g. HIA, SCI, Road Safety Audit, SuDS), and Grokbot's rows do not record that threshold.
issues.evidence: LBC row 'Lighting Assessment' trigger: 'Proposals involving the provision of publicly accessible developments, in the vicinity of residential property, a listed building or a conservation area...'

issues.detail: Rows with identical excerpts are counted as separate requirements: Transport Assessment and Travel Plan; CIL Form and S106 Heads of Terms; Environmental Statement and Roof plan; HIA, Landscaping and SCI (three rows, one excerpt); Retail Impact Assessment and Marketing/vacancy evidence.
issues.evidence: Transport Assessment and Travel Plan rows both: 'A Transport Assessment and Travel Plan, prepared by a suitably qualified traffic consultant, is required for all applications that generate significant additional traffic...'

summary: Grokbot's Hounslow link is only the Full planning (major/minor) checklist out of a set of per-application-type checklists (now at v.8), so every other application type was wrongly recorded as having no local requirements. Its full-planning rows carry triggers from the wrong table rows (e.g. HIA = 'finish materials'). The live sources could not be read because the shared WebFetch and WebSearch budgets ran out, so the version in force and its date are unverified.
